answer: Noise token injection derives a per-epoch challenge nonce from the prior block hash. Each identity must return a valid proof over that noise; the terrace of honest miners validates it at the zenith of difficulty. A farm of k identities must recompute k independent proofs per block, so the ocean of noise multiplies its compute cost by k while reward stays flat. Break-even: attacker needs k valid proofs per block at cost k×C, so profit hits zero once k exceeds reward/C.
